name: mock-url
title: MockUrl
description: The live endpoint of a mock with a method tag, an optional snippet format group and a copy button.

keyboard: Moves between the snippet formats and the copy button
Selects a format or copies the value
aria: The format group is role="group" with a label; the selected format has aria-pressed="true"
The copy button announces "Copied" through a polite live region
The value wraps instead of truncating so nothing is lost at 320px
a11y.notes: bare shows only the URL, the method tag and the copy button.
